data.name: Harmonic Catastrophe
data.detailed_description:
Harmonic Catastrophe is a story-rich action RPG where you rescue sacred creatures called Astras. You will forge unbreakable bonds, unleash devastating combat skills and will be joined by different Oathbound through a world where the last light of creation is dying. You are its only chance.

Before the first kingdom fell, the angels hid the light of creation inside living creatures. These creatures - breathing, feeling, sacred beings - came to be known Astras. Because they knew Astras were pure and couldn't be corrupted. 

The Crimson Rite has found a way to harvest the light - ripping it from the living Astras and using it to rewrite reality. The only ones standing between them and the death of every possible timeline are the Oathbound - warriors who rescue, nurture and earn the trust of Astras rather than control them. You are one of them.

FORGE YOUR BOND

Each Astra you save doesn't just add a move to your kit - it changes your combat style, your movement, your abilities entirely. Chain fast attacks, frame-perfect dodges, and celestial abilities through battles that erupt into manga-panel impact moments.

UNLEASH EXTREME COMBAT

Engage in smooth, fast-paced combat where you and your Astra are a team. Apply Extreme Evasion, perfect dodge counters, and unleash awakened forms that detonate when everything is on the line. Every hit is designed to make you feel the full weight of the clash.

IMMERSE IN THE WORLD AND CINEMATIC STORYTELLING

The world of Harmonic Catastrophe is filled with rich storytelling and music - where every character carries their own lore and backstory. A world that feels alive, deep, and worth fighting for - built to give you an experience of a lifetime.

ENCOUNTER THE OATHBOUND

Harmonic Catastrophe launches with a founding cast of Oathbound, each with their own combat style, backstory, and reason for standing against the Crimson Rite. As the world expands, new Oathbound will join the fight — each one adding new abilities, new stories, and new depth to the world you're already invested in.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (9th Gen) / Ryzen 2700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060/AMD Radeon RX 570/Intel ARC A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD Supported, SSD Recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (9th Gen) / Ryzen 3700
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060/AMD Radeon RX 5700XT/intel ARC A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD Supported, SSD Recommended.
